payload.summary: The account msmith on host victim-web-01 experienced a brute force attack from IP 10.77.0.64, with 10 failed login attempts followed by a successful login. The source IP is known to the account and has been used previously, but the pattern of failed attempts followed by a successful login suggests a potential compromise.

attack_chain.description: An attacker used brute force techniques to guess the password for the account msmith on host victim-web-01, with 10 failed login attempts followed by a successful login from IP 10.77.0.64.

proposed_actions.justification: The account msmith experienced a brute force attack, indicating a potential compromise. Disabling the account will prevent further unauthorized access.
